items.t: Listings here carry the board sub-area "Mission-West" with a "Mission" mailing address, on streets including Wilson Street, Hayward Street, Olson Avenue, Haffner Terrace, Silverdale Avenue, Keystone Avenue, Gunn Avenue, Nelson Street and Townshipline Avenue. This page covers the western side of the City of Mission — the Silverdale area and the rural fringe toward Stave Falls and Ruskin — and this area is inside the City, so City planning, zoning and tax rules are the relevant municipal frame.

Sub-area context, labelled as context only (dwellings, not land): Mission West, September 2026 — Detached 5 / 1 / 20%; Condos & Townhomes 8 / 0 / NA. Community context (not Mission West figures): Mission Detached median $814,000; Condos & Townhomes median $430,000, September 2026.

Transit and hospital anchors: West Coast Express — five weekday westbound trains from Mission City Station at 5:25–7:25 a.m. reach Waterfront Station in 75 minutes, five eastbound returns, no weekend or holiday service.

blocks.text: Good to know about Mission West lots

items.t: Mission West publishes no price of its own. The land itself has no published statistic at all.

Silverdale's growth story is real; a parcel's share of it is not yet written. The 3,440-acre SCPA designation, the Central Neighbourhood Plan and the Master Infrastructure Strategy are City-documented and underway — but no density, timing or servicing promise for an individual parcel is verified until it is read off that parcel's designation, zoning and the DSCB 5650-2017 process.

The far side of the city is far from its anchors. Mission City Station and Mission Memorial Hospital (7324 Hurd Street) both sit on the eastern/central side — a Mission West acreage buyer pricing a "75-minute West Coast Express commute" is pricing station-to-Waterfront time only.

items.t: "Mission West" is an MLS® sub-area name for the western side of the City of Mission — the Silverdale area and the rural fringe toward Stave Falls and Ruskin. Every listing we checked is labelled Mission-West, Mission, Status: Active, on Silverdale Avenue, Keystone Avenue, Nelson Street, Gunn Avenue, Wilson Road/Street and Townshipline Avenue.
Combined Mission community — Detached median $814,000; attached median $430,000, not Mission West figures.

The defining plan area: the Silverdale Comprehensive Planning Area is a 3,440-acre area, sometimes known as Southwest Mission, defined in Mission's Official Community Plan and designated for urban growth, with a Central Neighbourhood Plan process and a Master Infrastructure Strategy underway. The City's Rural Mission Strategy also covers this side of the city — "From Stave Falls, Steelhead and Silverdale to our other rural neighbourhoods" — building on the new Official Community Plan.
SD75's structure is elementary K–6, middle 7–9, secondary 10–12.

blocks.text: Good to know about Mission West lots

items.t: Silverdale is a plan in process, not a finished suburb (City sources, read Nov 1, 2026). The 3,440-acre Silverdale Comprehensive Planning Area is designated for urban growth in the OCP, but its Central Neighbourhood Plan and Master Infrastructure Strategy are still underway — a Silverdale parcel's value story is a timing question the listing cannot answer; only the in-force designation and zoning for the PID can.
The 20% ratio is one sale (Sep 2026). Present it as a thin-market signal, never as proof Mission West is Mission's hottest market.

faq.q: When are property taxes due on a Mission West lot, and what is the penalty?

faq.a: No — a manufactured home in a park is a home on a rented pad. MHPTA pad-rent limits are Act percentages only (2026 = 2.3% + proportional).
faq.q: Are the Wilson Street park homes a way to buy land cheaply?

faq.a: No — they are manufactured homes on rented pads with park-approval requirements: pad tenure, not land.
faq.q: Are the Wilson Street park homes acreage?

faq.a: Confirm current pad rent and park rules from the park's own documents before writing.
faq.q: Are the Wilson Street park homes a way into Mission West land?

faq.a: Mission requires every secondary suite to be registered with the City, suites sit inside a single family home as part of the same real estate entity, and suites are not permitted in townhouses or rowhomes; the annual suite fee is $63 plus utility fees.
faq.q: Can a duplex in Mission West also carry a suite?

faq.a: A flat 10% on current balances outstanding, added July 3, 2026 — the City of Mission regime. The 5% + 5% rural regime belongs to FVRD electoral areas and does not apply to a Mission West home inside the City.
faq.q: I missed Mission's July 2 tax deadline — what is the penalty?

faq.a: Yes — the Mission West board sub-area (Silverdale and the western rural fringe toward Stave Falls) sits inside the City of Mission, so City planning, zoning and tax rules apply; Silverdale is defined in the City's Official Community Plan as the 3,440-acre Silverdale Comprehensive Planning Area designated for urban growth.
faq.q: Is Mission West part of the City of Mission?

faq.a: The City of Mission's 3,440-acre planning area in southwest Mission (sometimes known as Southwest Mission), designated in the Official Community Plan for urban growth and being planned through a Central Neighbourhood Plan and a Master Infrastructure Strategy.
